en.headline: sogeisetsu 修复 CI 与活动分页问题，新增 AI 失败自动诊断功能
en.summary: `sogeisetsu` made **9 own commits** to `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` plus 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Key fixes include: `opencode.yml` no longer uses `toLower` (unavailable in GitHub expressions), `check.yml` summary window assertion no longer hard-compares against "today" (root cause of midnight failures), and event pagination treats HTTP 422 as non-fatal by relying on the `Link` header. A new feature adds AI failure auto-diagnosis with a manual `/oc` fallback entry. Two temporary test commits verified the "non-owner comment → skipped" path and forced a real AI failure, then were reverted. The user opened or closed 5 issues, all being issue #9 (`[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）`) which was opened, commented on 3 times, and then closed with 5 total comments. In `openchamber/openchamber`, issues #4111 and #4899 were both closed by `yulia-ivashko`. Three replies were received: one from `yulia-ivashko` on `openchamber/openchamber#4899` and two from `github-actions[bot]` on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu#9`.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 修复 CI 与活动分页问题，新增 AI 失败自动诊断功能
zh.summary: `sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库完成 **9 次本人提交**，另有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。主要修复包括：`opencode.yml` 不再使用 `toLower`（GitHub 表达式不支持该函数），`check.yml` 的 summary 窗口断言不再与"此刻的今天"硬比（这是半夜必红的根因），事件分页将 HTTP 422 视为非致命错误并以 `Link` 头为准。新增功能为 AI 全失败自动诊断及 `/oc` 手动补查入口。两次临时测试提交验证了"非本人评论 → skipped"路径并制造了一次真实 AI 失败，随后已回退。用户新开或关闭 5 个 issue，均为 issue #9（`[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）`），该 issue 被新开、评论 3 次后关闭，共 5 条评论。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 中，issue #4111 和 #4899 均由 `yulia-ivashko` 关闭。收到 3 条回复：1 条来自 `yulia-ivashko` 在 `openchamber/openchamber#4899`，2 条来自 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu#9`。
